office.private: Only you, its lead, its helpers and the Admin see this to-do.
office.sheetNote: Office to-do. Only its people and the Admin see it.
office.readOnly: You can view this to-do. Only its lead and the person who made it can change it.
office.helpersHint: Helpers tick checklist items and comment. Only the lead finishes the to-do.
office.needsReviewHint: The person who made the to-do checks it before it is done.

reasons.not_a_person: Only a person can lead or help on a to-do. An agent acts for its person.
reasons.office_no_stage: An office to-do belongs to no project, so it has no stage.
reasons.office_no_prerequisites: An office to-do does not wait for other to-dos.
reasons.review_by_maker: The person who made this to-do reviews it. A to-do that this person leads needs no review.
reasons.file_office_task: A file of an office to-do stays on its to-do.
reasons.office_needs_task: Choose the project or the office to-do of this file.
